    --output-file "$OUTPUT_DIR/counterfactuals.jsonl" \

77	                f"Example:\nOriginal ({opposite}): {example['original']}\n"
78	                f"Rewritten ({direction}): {example['rewritten']}\n\n"
79	                f"Now rewrite this text to be more {direction}:\n\n{text}"
80	            ),
